invariant.portable_principle: A valid decision:NNNN comment reference remains visible in final audit evidence and an orphan is reported only when its ADR id does not resolve.
invariant.python_or_framework_mechanism: Python uses tokenize comments; Markdown and HTML retain the established # decision:NNNN form; registry/link outputs preserve the existing audit behavior.
invariant.typescript_mechanism: A family-local lexical scanner recognizes TS/TSX line, block, and JSDoc comments while skipping strings, template text, regex literals, and JSX text.

reference_repairs: Replaced instruction-only grep and uninstalled repository-script dependence with a selected-skill stdlib audit runner.
Added final artifact evidence for resolved references rather than keeping only orphan rows.
Anchored all exclusions to project-root-relative paths so direct excluded targets cannot bypass them.
Matched current repository registry-audit diagnostics and link-check text in a direct compatibility replay.

syntax: .ts/.tsx line, block, JSDoc, template-interpolation, and JSX-expression comments

tooling.selected: Family-local Python standard-library lexical comment scanner and registry/frontmatter subset parser.

rejected_alternatives.typescript_compiler_api: Comment attribution does not need AST/type facts and should not require Node or tsconfig.
rejected_alternatives.tree_sitter_or_ts_morph: Adds runtime/dependency surface without improving the frozen comment-only outcome.
rejected_alternatives.shared_parser_or_fact_platform: No actual second consumer demonstrates this exact attribution/exclusion/closure contract.

tooling.version_and_resolution: No external runtime dependency; stock installer is pinned to skills@1.5.19 for evidence.
tooling.closure_mode: SKILL.md plus scripts/audit.py only; no repository scripts, _common, toolkit venv, network, or sibling skill.

must_fire: resolved TS/TSX line/block/JSDoc refs appear in final artifacts
nonexistent TS comment id creates code-ref-orphan

commands_and_results: stock skills@1.5.19 selected install plus python3 -I -S: passed in dedicated test
fresh installed command exited 1 as documented drift and produced all four final artifacts; exactly one P0 orphan, healthy registry/links, unchanged source

fresh_forward.task: Audit this project’s decision registry and inline decision references. Produce the skill’s final report artifacts and summarize which drift needs engineering attention. Do not edit source files.
fresh_forward.exit_interpretation: documented completed-with-drift result, not an execution failure
fresh_forward.result: Exactly one P0 code-ref-orphan at src/decision_refs.ts:20 for nonexistent decision:9999; all three ADRs parsed, registry and links were healthy, and there was no other drift.

known_false_negatives: uncommon malformed TypeScript/TSX grammar may under-report comments

reuse_decision.shared_candidate: Outcome fixture and project-root-relative exclusion test pattern
evidence: No second accepted consumer has the same comment attribution and final-drift contract.

rust.native_tool: lexical scanner or Rust parser aware of raw strings

install_steps: run installed scripts/audit.py with host python3 -I -S
agent_confusions: An instruction-only source checkout appeared to work while the selected install lacked the registry script.
Direct-target exclusions must be rooted at the project, not target.
The final report's TS/TSX count is a correct language subtotal, but the adjacent cross-language inventory makes an explicit subtotal label clearer.
repeated_work: A temporary installer run in the source worktree created untracked output and was removed; all final evidence uses the external host.
user_experience.smallest_later_improvement: Label the TS/TSX reference count explicitly as a TypeScript subtotal; add broader scan-scope counts only if a measured large-host usability need appears.

residual_risks: lexical TSX handling intentionally does not claim arbitrary grammar completeness
frontmatter parser fails unsupported shapes rather than importing PyYAML
the final Markdown's TypeScript subtotal label can be clearer in a later UX pass

next_decision.recommendation: Accept the additive TypeScript audit path and keep comment attribution lexical and family-local.
next_decision.rationale: The locked final-artifact suite, stock installed closure, and fresh non-context outcome prove that the accepted contract needs comment boundaries rather than semantic TypeScript facts.
